16513297.topic_title: Cursor 不能切模型了, 锁定 auto
16513297.content:
```
{
"http.proxy": "http://127.0.0.1:7890",// 你的代理端口
"cursor.general.disableHttp2": true,
"cursor.general.disableHttp1SSE": true,
"http.proxyAuthorization": null,
"http.noProxy": [],
"window.commandCenter": true,
"http.proxySupport": "override"
}
```
参考： https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/xle2vUOc5Cv4qqrPl2klqg
